title.narrative: Project Preparation Facility in the Energy Sector

description.narrative:
Avsikten med insatsen är att underlätta för utvecklingen av energisektorn i Moçambique genom att tillgängliggöra medel för strategiska studier som syftar till att främja förbättringar och utveckling av elsystemet och förvaltning av sektorn och därigenom på medellång till lång sikt möjliggöra förbättrad tillgång till förnybart producerad el för landets befolkning. Huvuddelen av studierna kommer att bestå av genomförbarhetsstudier för ny elproduktion, transmission och energieffektivisering, bedömningar med avseende på socioekonomi, gender och miljökonsekvenser samt studier relaterade till kapacitetsuppbyggnad. För genomförandet av studierna ansvarar det nationella elbolaget EDM på uppdrag av Moçambique. Val av studierna är baserat på ett antal kriterier och EDM ansöker separat för varje studie om att få använda medel. Sverige skall godkänna (eller avslå) ansökningarna och EDM upphandlar därefter konsulter för genomförandet av respektive studie. EDMs upphandlingsförfarande av konsultinsatser för att utföra studierna är baserat på ett no objection to från Sverige i olika skeden av upphandlingsprocessen i enlighet med Sidas upphandlingsregler (Sida Procurement Guidelines, SPG). För att ytterligare öka fokus på hållbarhetsaspekter kommer kravställningen vad avser hållbarhetskriterier för upphandling av konsultinsatserna att ses över och förstärkas.
I syfte att facilitera implementeringen och följa upp aktiviteterna, avser ambassaden handla upp en extern konsult.
Genomförandet av insatsen planeras för perioden 2017-2021, med en total finansiering från Sida om 52 500 000 kr.

The aim of the intervention is to finance a number of studies in the energy sector of Mozambique to enable a continued expansion of electricity generated from renewable energy sources, and the development of the energy system at large. Studies are also planned within the area of energy efficiency, and for Environment and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs) with an additional focus on gender. The intervention is set for 2017-2021, with at total budget of 52.5 MSEK. The implementing organisation is the state utility of Mozambique (EDM).

title.narrative: Decision on Contribution Project Preparation Facility in the Energy Sector

description.narrative:
The project Preparation Facility is comprised of the following projects with the following results achieved so far:
(a) Tsate ESIA Final report of the study has been submitted and approved by the ministry of lands and environment (MTA). Sweden is working with kFw, the European Investment Bank and the European Union for financial closure for the implementation of the project as a follow up or result of the study. Although the study has been approved by the MTA further studies are needed by the financiers but it has been agreed that these studies will be carried out by the owners engineer during the first phase of the project, for example design of optimal dam height. Although it is EDM's responsibility to pay for resettlement costs the financiers are of a strong opinion that the number of resettled families currently living in the area that will be flooded as a result of the construction of the dam should be reduced to the minimum to avoid possible reputational risks. The implementation of the Tsate Hydro Power Plant will meet one of the contemplated outcomes of the PPF i.e. increasing generation capacity by 50MW. Futhermore the major risk of extensive resettlement has been mitigated by changing the route of the transmission line by upgrading an existing line.
(b) Bundled Transmission Network Studies Project concluded, Sweden is currently working with other donors to cofinance a package of 2 transmission lines, the Massinga Vilanculos TL and the Nampula Angoche TL. For this package Sweden has committed MSEK350, EU Meur10, KfW MEur 10 and the EIB Meur 50.
(c) Feasibility Studies for the rehabilitation of distribution networks in Nampula, Angoche and Xai Xai Project concluded information from these studies is being used for the implementation of the Proenergia project.
(d) Massinga Vilanculos Transmission Line (TL) Feasibility Study (FS) The final ESIA report was submitted to MTA for approval in December 2022 and approved on March 2023. This project is contemplated under the transmission lines package of which Sweden has committed to finance and is negotiating with other donors for co-financing.
(e) LOT 1 FS 110KV Nampula Angoche Ongoing The feasibility study of this project which forms part of the transmission package to which Sweden has already committed to finance is underway and the inception report has already been submitted. This project will be implemented also together and in coordination with the Proenergia project.
(f) LOT2 Reconstruction of Cabo Delgado Province Ongoing The feasibility study for this project is ongoing and an initial final draft report has been submitted for review by the financiers, Sweden included, who have committed to finance this project. Sweden has committed MSEK150, Norway MNok 150 and the EU will delegate MEur 15 to Sweden for this project. The appraisal of this project is expected to initiate beginning of 2025 and financial closure by Q4 2024.
